findings.title: All 13 service/config exception raise sites are untranslated; strings.json has no exceptions section
findings.claim: All 13 raise sites of HomeAssistantError/ServiceValidationError in the integration build their message as an English f-string with no translation_key/translation_domain, and strings.json and translations/en.json carry 0 exceptions-section keys, so service and config errors are English-only even for users running a translated UI.
findings.mechanism: The service handlers in __init__:_async_register_services and _loaded_entries raise ServiceValidationError with inline f-strings (e.g. __init__.py:427 'No loaded Heat Pump Optimizer config entry matched this call'), and coordinator.async_set_target_temperature (coordinator.py:1370) does the same; no exceptions section exists in strings.json/en.json/sv.json for a translation_key to point at, so the gold exception-translations rule cannot be satisfied without adding both the raise-site kwargs and the translation keys.

evidence.unit: count of untranslated raise sites (0 of 13 translatable; 0 exceptions-section keys in strings.json and en.json)
evidence.contention_note: shared 8-core box during the eleven-auditor fan-out (load1 3.81); counts only, contention-immune

perturbation.change: On a /tmp copy of the integration (HPO_D10A_INT=<copy>), add translation_key="no_entries", translation_domain=DOMAIN to the ServiceValidationError raise at __init__.py:427

findings.metric_definition: Count raise sites of HomeAssistantError/ServiceValidationError whose Call node carries translation_key or translation_domain vs total such raise sites, plus key count of the exceptions section in strings.json and translations/en.json.
reproduction_steps: Run the harness command in evidence; read exception-translations.raises_translatable (0), raise_sites_total (13), exceptions_section_strings.json (0).
Copy custom_components/heatpump_optimizer to /tmp, edit __init__.py:427 to add translation_key/translation_domain kwargs.
Re-run with HPO_D10A_INT pointing at the copy; raises_translatable moves 0 -> 1.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Add an exceptions section to strings.json, translations/en.json and translations/sv.json (13 keys, several shareable), and pass translation_domain=DOMAIN, translation_key and translation_placeholders at all 13 raise sites in __init__.py (413, 417, 427, 558, 605, 611, 656, 722, 765, 788, 832, 846) and coordinator.py:1370.

non_findings.claim: All 11 hass.services.async_register sites sit in the async_setup call chain (via _async_register_services, called at __init__.py:393); 0 elsewhere.
Polling interval is 30 minutes by default, user-bounded 10-120 via a UI slider step 5, on the single DataUpdateCoordinator; no SCAN_INTERVAL.
The DataUpdateCoordinator lives in coordinator.py and each platform file carries its own platform-specific base class; no cross-platform entity boilerplate goes unshared.
non_findings.value: coordinator_py_dataupdatecoordinator=1, entity_py_exists=0, own bases sensor=2/binary_sensor=1/button=1, importing_shared=0

non_findings.claim: Config flow provides stepped UI setup (26 step functions) and the options flow persists into entry.options, not entry.data.
No entity subscribes to events/state outside the CoordinatorEntity pattern; the 3 real subscriptions live in coordinator helpers with stored unsub cleanup (coordinator.py:5019-5024).
All 65 entities set a unique_id (f"{entry_id}_{key}"; per-entity keys statically re-derived) and no two collide within or across platforms.
non_findings.value: entity_classes_total=65, derived_unique_ids=65, collisions=0, suffix_shared_across_platforms=0; collision detector proven by /tmp perturbation 0->1

non_findings.claim: Every entity class resolves _attr_has_entity_name=True (set in each platform base).
A typed ConfigEntry alias is defined and runtime data lives on entry.runtime_data; nothing reads hass.data[DOMAIN].

async_setup_entry validates it can fetch (Tibber/weather/solar) before completing: first refresh raises UpdateFailed on failure in both the full and the light path, which HA converts to ConfigEntryNotReady; the only except in setup is the bounded, logged version lookup.
Service handlers raise ServiceValidationError for invalid usage at 13 sites and no handler silently swallows an exception.
PARALLEL_UPDATES is declared in every platform module: 0 for the coordinator-driven read-only sensor/binary_sensor platforms, 1 for the actuating button/climate/switch platforms.
manifest.json codeowners is non-empty.
The integration creates one well-formed DeviceInfo (identifiers, manufacturer, model, sw_version) shared by every platform.
non_findings.value: deviceinfo_sites=1 (coordinator.py:1328), with identifiers=1, manufacturer=1, model=1, sw_version=1

non_findings.claim: All internal-signal entities carry EntityCategory.DIAGNOSTIC; the 48 uncategorized entities are primary user-facing values, none is an internal signal left exposed.

29 of 55 sensors carry a SensorDeviceClass and none of the 26 without has an applicable HA device class (money rolling predictions, percent, ratio, text, plan payloads; MONETARY/ENERGY require state_class TOTAL - deliberate, documented at sensor.py:377).
non_findings.value: sensors_with_device_class=29, sensors_without=26, applicable_missing=0 (per-class audit in REPORT.md)

non_findings.claim: The niche/diagnostic tail of the entity set is disabled by default: exactly 6 entities.
non_findings.value: disabled_entities=6 of 65 (ECL110Displace, ECL110EffectiveDisplace, ContractComparison, DHWHeavyDay, ValveTargetRecommendation, FrequencyAdvisor)

non_findings.claim: Every entity has a translation_key present in strings.json, en.json and sv.json entity sections, except the one device-named climate entity which is exempt by design.
Repair issues are used with actionable metadata: 13 ir.async_create_issue sites, each with severity and translation_key, all keys present in strings.json issues (14 keys).
Exemption basis for discovery: zero discovery-mechanism imports (no zeroconf/ssdp/dhcp/usb/bluetooth); the integration binds a cloud API (Tibber, iot_class=cloud_polling) and user-picked HA entities.
Exemption basis for discovery-update-info: no network addresses exist in device state to update (same zero-import evidence).
Exemption basis for dynamic-devices: no device-registry create sites; one static DeviceInfo per config entry.

Exemption basis for stale-devices: no async_remove_config_entry_device; device lifetime equals config-entry lifetime, and retired entity-registry entries are already cleaned at every setup (__init__.py:360).

Zero blocking-IO calls inside async defs; the one time.sleep sits in the sync solver dispatched via async_add_executor_job (coordinator.py:4750); persistence uses HA Store.async_save; HTTP is aiohttp.
No ad-hoc aiohttp.ClientSession is constructed anywhere; all three HTTP entry points obtain the shared session via async_get_clientsession.
